title: 高分子化学
subtitle: Polymer Chemistry
teachers:
YOSHIMURA Osamu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: You learn the characteristics of polymeric materials necessary for basic knowledge of chemical engineers compared with low molecular weight materials. And you understand the physical properties, synthesis methods and applications of polymers.
advice:
1. What is polymer (structure, thermal properties, viscoelasticity, strength as a material, etc) ?
2. How many types of polymers are classified?
3. Synthesis and molding methods of polymers.
4. Explain each polymer with properties and applications (Applications of polymer such as functional polymers)?
5. Testing methods for the mechanical strength of polymers
Every time, prepare and review. Keeping in mind that our life can not be done without polymers, studying with interest.
books:
Textbooks:　Kenji Yokota(2016), Koubunshi wo manabou (Kagaku-Dojin Publishing Company,INC)
Reference Books:　Unspecified
Reserved Books in the Library:　Shouhei Inoue(2006), Hajimete no Koubunshi Kagaku(Kagaku-Dojin Publishing Company,INC)
requiredKnowledge: Let's examine what kind of plastics, rubber, fiber, adhesive, paint are around us. These are all polymers.

activityGoals.body: Find out what kind of position the polymer is in the materials.
Understand the type and properties of polymers synthesized by humans on the market.
Explain the molecular weights and molecular weight distribution of the polymer.
Understand crystal part and amorphous part of polymers.
Understand the glass transition temperature and melting point.
Explain the difference in properties between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.

achievementLevels.ideal:
It is possible to accurately explain the following issues.
The difference between polymer material and low molecular weight material.
Several kinds of polymer can be said and it can explain exactly what kind of field it is used.
The molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of polymer.
The difference between the crystal part and the amorphous part of polymer.
The characteristic glass transition point of polymer.
The difference (kind, applied field, etc.) between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.
achievementLevels.standard:

The difference between polymer material and low molecular weight material.

The molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of the polymer.

The difference (kind, applied field, etc.) between thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin.
